name: TBM mobilités
use: Plan Bordeaux tram, bus, and river-shuttle trips and check service updates.

name: SNCF Connect
use: Book and manage French trains, including independent trips toward Arcachon or Saint-Émilion.

name: CARRISway
use: Check Lisbon bus, tram, and funicular routes and real-time arrivals.
caveat: Lisbon Metro contactless payment rules do not automatically apply on every CARRIS vehicle.

name: CP – Comboios de Portugal
use: Manage the Lisbon–Porto train and check suburban or Douro regional services.

name: Anda
use: Validate participating Porto Metro, bus, and train journeys by phone.
caveat: Android only; NFC and Bluetooth are required. iPhone users should use a physical Andante ticket or card.

name: Bolt
use: Use for airport transfers, luggage trips, late nights, and urban transit gaps.
caveat: Do not assume availability in rural Armagnac, vineyards, Bazas, or the Douro.

name: ANA Portuguese Airports
use: Check official Lisbon and Porto airport flight and terminal information.

name: Lisbon Metro
use: Keep Metro maps, travel guidance, fares, and contactless-payment rules handy.
caveat: One contactless card or device covers one passenger; use the same payment credential throughout a trip.

name: Andante
use: Check Porto-area zones, fares, physical tickets, and participating operators.

name: Nouvelle-Aquitaine Transport
use: Check regional coaches and service notices outside Bordeaux’s local TBM network.

name: Bordeaux Airport
use: Check official flight status, airport access, and ground transportation.

name: Lisbon Airport
use: Check official airport arrivals, departures, and transportation.

name: Porto Airport
use: Check official airport status and early-morning transportation information.

name: Underground Saint-Émilion tickets
use: Prebook a dated, language-specific underground-monuments tour if visiting independently.

name: Livraria Lello tickets
use: Buy the required timed Ticket-Voucher if this optional stop makes the final plan.
